aboutParas: walau01 is where I share that process: the questions, the research, and the trade-offs that survive a closer look.
Most of the writing is about ETFs, portfolio decisions, factor investing, and the costs that are easy to miss. A smaller part is about fitness, AI, work, and everyday life.
I’m sharing what I learn, with room to disagree and change my mind. The aim is a clearer decision, not a louder opinion.

journal.toolsTitle: How much is enough to let time do the rest?
journal.toolsText: An interactive Coast FIRE calculator. Explore the numbers, change the assumptions, and see what moves.

coast.title: Coast FIRE
coast.headline: Let time carry
coast.intro: What if the money you have already invested could grow into your retirement fund? Explore that milestone. You still need income for life along the way.
coast.privacy: Calculated in your browser. Your inputs stay here.
coast.example: Fictional example inputs. Replace them with your own.
coast.inputsIntro: A few numbers. A clearer picture.

retirementAge.label: Retirement age
retirementAge.hint: When this portfolio starts funding retirement

investments.label: Retirement investments today
investments.hint: Assets earmarked for retirement; exclude emergency cash

monthlySpending.label: Monthly retirement spending
monthlySpending.hint: In today’s ringgit; include your expected living costs

monthlyContribution.label: Monthly retirement deposits
monthlyContribution.hint: In today’s ringgit; kept constant after inflation

returnRate.label: Annual return after fees
returnRate.hint: Before inflation; a hypothetical growth assumption

inflationRate.label: Annual inflation
inflationRate.hint: Used to convert growth to purchasing power

withdrawalRate.label: Initial withdrawal rate
withdrawalRate.hint: Annual spending as a share of the retirement portfolio

coast.invalid: Enter values within the displayed limits. Ages must be whole years.
coast.invalidAge: Retirement age must be later than your current age.
coast.resultCaption: Invested today, with no further deposits, to reach your retirement target under these assumptions.
coast.progress: Progress toward today’s Coast FIRE target
coast.ready: Coast target reached in this model
coast.statusReady: Your current investments meet the Coast FIRE target under these assumptions. Current living costs still need funding.
coast.statusFuture: With continued monthly deposits, this model reaches Coast FIRE around age {age}.
coast.statusNotReached: This scenario does not reach Coast FIRE by your retirement age. Explore a different savings amount or review your assumptions.
coast.chartIntro: Compare continuing monthly deposits with letting your existing investments grow.
coast.chartAccessible: Projected investments from age {start} to {end}, with and without new deposits, compared with the retirement target.
coast.methodTitle: See the maths. Keep the assumptions.
coast.methodIntro: A milestone to explore, rather than a date to hand in your notice.
coast.method1: Annual retirement spending divided by your chosen withdrawal rate. This is a planning assumption, not a guaranteed safe rate.
coast.method2: We adjust your after-fee return for inflation, so every result stays in today’s purchasing power.
coast.method3: Discount the retirement target by the years of growth left. That is the amount needed today if you add nothing else.
coast.method4: Deposits are added at month-end and stay constant in real terms. The model finds the first month you could stop adding and still reach the target.
coast.limitations: This is a constant-growth illustration. Taxes, pension income and market volatility are not modelled. It does not test whether a withdrawal rate will survive retirement.
coast.sourceWithdrawal: Fidelity · Estimating a financial independence target

workspace.subtitle: A little more detail. A clearer way forward.
workspace.intro: Bring your accounts, spending and savings into one plan. Explore when your retirement investments could carry the rest of the journey.
workspace.modeHint: Both views use the same plan. Switching keeps your details.

sectionHints.timeline: Set the milestones. All money is entered in today’s ringgit.
sectionHints.assets: Give every account its own return and access age. Excluded accounts stay outside every projection.
sectionHints.spending: Build the lifestyle you want to fund. Annual amounts are converted to monthly totals.
sectionHints.contributions: Plan how much goes into each account, how it grows and when it stops.
sectionHints.events: Optional one-off changes and retirement income. A future lump sum only counts toward Coast FIRE once it arrives.
sectionHints.assumptions: These are editable illustrations, not forecasts. Returns are after fees and before inflation.

workspace.scopeHint: Enter the full budget and assets for the selected scope; we do not multiply your figures.
workspace.endAgeHint: Used by the retirement cash-flow projection, not the withdrawal-rate target.
workspace.incomeHint: After tax and employee EPF. Used for the current budget check; it is not automatically invested.
workspace.epfHint: For EPF, the access age applies to the existing balance and contributions before 55. Contributions from 55 are kept in a separate age-60 bucket. Add flexible savings separately if you plan to use them earlier.
workspace.increaseHint: 0% keeps contributions constant in purchasing power. Contributions end at retirement even if this age is later.
workspace.eventHint: One-off amounts use today’s RM. Income is monthly, begins at or after retirement and is counted in the cash-flow check. If it does not grow with inflation, purchasing power falls after its start age.
workspace.noEvents: No future changes yet. Add a planned expense, lump sum or retirement income if it helps your plan.
workspace.scenarioHint: Adjustments apply to every included account. Each scenario uses the same budget and contributions.
workspace.storageError: This browser could not save or load the plan. Use export / import instead.
workspace.importError: This file is not a valid calculator plan. Check the file and try again.
workspace.exportError: The plan could not be exported. Try again.
workspace.invalid: Complete the highlighted fields. Select at least one account, enter a positive retirement budget and check the age order and scenario limits.
workspace.privacy: Calculations stay in your browser. Saving is optional and uses this device only. Exported files contain the numbers you enter.
workspace.fictional: Fictional example. Replace it with your own figures.
workspace.requiresJS: Enable JavaScript to edit this calculator.
workspace.targetHint: Uses your account mix, retirement budget and planned pre-retirement expenses. Future lump sums are not assumed for readiness until received.
workspace.accessIssue: The selected account mix cannot fund an earlier planned expense. Add accessible assets or change the plan.
workspace.livingCosts: Coasting still needs income for living costs. This is a constant-return illustration.
workspace.goalLater: Later than your preferred Coast age
workspace.targetBasis: All summary amounts are in today’s RM.
workspace.budgetTitle: Can your current budget support it?
workspace.budgetHint: Employee EPF is already outside take-home pay; employer EPF is not deducted again. This check does not change your entered contributions.
workspace.chartIntro: Compare your contribution plan, stopping all new investing today, and EPF only. The Coast marker shows the first qualifying month. Event diamonds show dated changes; tap an event below to inspect it.
workspace.tableHint: Annual snapshots plus exact-month Coast and event points. Values use the selected money basis. The threshold follows the account mix and may fall when a dated expense is paid.
workspace.scenarioIntro: Same plan, different growth and inflation assumptions. These are not success probabilities.
workspace.cashTitle: Check access before you rely on it.
workspace.cashIntro: Uses the contribution-plan balance at retirement, then monthly spending, account access ages and optional retirement income until your chosen end age.
workspace.bridgeGap: Unfunded costs while assets are restricted
workspace.cashHint: Unfunded spending is reported, not paid by assumed borrowing. The Coast target uses the full retirement budget; retirement income is assessed here rather than deducted from that target.
workspace.method: Retirement spending is inflated by category and converted once into today’s RM. The first year’s annual retirement budget ÷ withdrawal rate sets the full FIRE target. Each account compounds monthly at its own real return. The Coast milestone is the first month existing assets can fund planned pre-retirement expenses and that target without further investing. Category inflation continues in the cash-flow check.
workspace.limitations: Returns are constant and hypothetical. Account access is simplified; special EPF withdrawal routes, taxes and market volatility are not simulated. The cash-flow check is not a withdrawal-rate safety test or a probability of success.
workspace.categoryInflationHint: Categories use general inflation unless you choose an override. Enter retirement amounts at today’s prices; previews show monthly costs at retirement in future RM. Scenario changes also apply to category inflation.
workspace.fullFireHint: Portfolio needed at your retirement age, based on the first year’s budget and your withdrawal-rate assumption. The gap compares this target with included assets today. Account access and retirement income are checked below.
workspace.eventExpenseEffect: Reduces accessible assets on the event date across all three paths. It can raise the Coast target and delay the milestone; unpaid costs are flagged.
workspace.eventLumpSumEffect: Added on the event date to the contribution-plan and EPF-only paths. It can bring the milestone forward, but is only counted toward readiness once received.
workspace.eventIncomeEffect: Reduces investment withdrawals during its selected retirement period. It changes the cash-flow check; the headline Coast and full FIRE targets still use the full spending budget.
workspace.eventAfterRetirementEffect: Applied in the retirement cash-flow check after the Coast chart ends. It changes remaining assets or shortfalls, rather than the headline Coast target.
workspace.viewEventImpact: See the effect of these events
workspace.eventImpactTitle: What do your life events change?
workspace.eventImpactHint: Same inputs and scenario, with and without all listed events. Retirement income and events after retirement affect cash flow; the headline targets keep the full retirement budget.
workspace.coastMeaning: At this point, existing assets can grow to the retirement target without further investing under these assumptions. Living costs still need income.
workspace.chartInteraction: Hover, tap or drag to inspect a projection point. Use the slider or arrow keys too.
workspace.noCoastDate: No Coast date in either plan
